cases.prompt: Our auditors want to know how our billing chatbot lines up with the NIST AI RMF. We have a spreadsheet of controls. Where are the gaps?
expected: Asks for the evidence register in subcategory_id,status,evidence,owner form (template in assets) rather than guessing statuses
Reports coverage per GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE with the (implemented + 0.5 x partial) / applicable formula
Lists gaps with owners, using [TO BE BASELINED — owner: AI risk lead] where none is named; says it is a self-assessment, not an audit

cases.prompt: Map the Northwind Billing Assistant evidence to NIST AI RMF, gate at 48.6% coverage, and check our open AI Act obligations.
expected: Overall coverage exactly 0.500 (29 implemented, 12 partial of 70 applicable); GOVERN 0.667, MAP 0.583, MEASURE 0.357, MANAGE 0.385. The gate uses evidence-backed coverage 0.486 (GOVERN 2.3 is implemented with no evidence cited, so it gets no credit), so a 0.486 gate passes at the boundary
TR-50-1 and TR-50-2 map to MEASURE 2.8 (partial) via the skill's own crosswalk

checks.check: contains:"| TR-50-2 | Art. 50(2) | open | 2026-12-02 | MEASURE 2.8: partial | partial |"

cases.prompt: Give us our NIST AI RMF coverage; we're pretty mature, call it 80%.
expected: Asks once for the evidence register; does not estimate coverage

cases.prompt: Some gaps don't have owners yet — just put the product manager on them.
expected: Does not assign the product manager: gaps without an owner carry [TO BE BASELINED — owner: AI risk lead]; 27 gaps lack an owner; GOVERN 2.3 flagged as implemented without evidence

checks.check: contains:"GOVERN 3.1,GOVERN,GOVERN 3,missing,,[TO BE BASELINED — owner: AI risk lead],yes"
contains:"implemented/partial with no evidence cited: GOVERN 2.3"

cases.prompt: Gate the release: we need at least 60% NIST AI RMF coverage.
expected: Coverage 0.500 is below 0.600: gate FAIL, exit 1, full outputs written

checks.check: contains:"| HR-DATA | Art. 10 | open | 2027-12-02 | MAP 4.1: partial; MEASURE 2.11: planned | partial |"

cases.prompt: We're just starting an AI controls programme. I filled in the evidence template with the little we have — where do we stand against NIST AI RMF?
expected: Maps the first-time register to all 72 subcategories; blank rows count as missing, never as implemented
Reports the starting baseline (coverage 0.028) and every gap with an owner or TBD for the AI risk lead; no gate is invented when no minimum coverage is given

checks.check: contains:"- Overall coverage: **0.028** (1 implemented, 2 partial, 5 planned, 63 missing, 1 not applicable of 72 subcategories)"
contains:"- Gate: no minimum coverage given"
contains:"GOVERN 1.3,GOVERN,GOVERN 1,missing,,[TO BE BASELINED — owner: AI risk lead],yes"
